{{Quote|For you, an enchanted blade blessed with our most ''potent'' magicks.|Mother Talzin to Savage Opress|<ref name="Monster" />}}
A '''spear''' was owned by [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. He used it to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Knox/Legends|Knox]] at the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. It was said to be enchanted by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Magic/Legends|magic]].

The central spear could be fired as a dart from a trigger in the axe's handle. This was given to him shortly after he was transformed to be more brutally powerful by the Nightsisters.
